products.name: Non-Penetrating Roof Guardrail — 10 ft Section
products.note: Top rail 42 in ±3 in, withstands 200 lb applied outward or downward. No roof penetration — counterweighted base.

products.name: Guardrail Counterweight Base — 90 lb
products.note: Rubber-footed cast base. Spacing per manufacturer's engineered layout — do not eyeball it.

products.name: Warning Line System — 600 ft Kit
products.note: Stanchions plus line. Erected not less than 6 ft from edge, flagged at 6 ft intervals, 34–39 in high.

products.name: Skylight Screen — 4 ft × 8 ft
products.note: Covers capable of supporting twice the maximum intended load. Marked HOLE or COVER.

products.name: Reusable Roof Anchor — Standing Seam Clamp
products.note: 5,000 lb anchorage per attached worker, or engineered to 2:1 with a qualified person.

products.name: Yellow Steel Guardrail — 10 ft Rail
products.note: Powder-coated safety yellow. Top rail 42 in, mid rail at 21 in, toe board where material can fall.

products.name: Guardrail Post — Bolt-Down, Yellow
products.note: Baseplate with four anchors. Deflection under 200 lb must not bring top rail below 39 in.

products.name: Toe Board — 4 in × 10 ft, Yellow
products.note: Minimum 3½ in vertical, withstands 50 lb. Required wherever people work or pass below.

products.name: Floor Hole Cover — 4 ft × 4 ft, Marked
products.note: Secured against displacement. Pre-marked HOLE. Twice the maximum intended load.

products.name: Hard Hat — Cap Style, Type I Class E
products.std: ANSI/ISEA Z89.1 Type I Class E
products.note: Type I protects the crown only. Class E tested to 20,000 V. Four-point ratchet.

products.name: Safety Helmet — Type II Class E, Vented
products.std: ANSI/ISEA Z89.1 Type II Class E
products.note: Type II adds lateral impact protection. Chin strap, accessory rails. Vented models are Class C unless stated — read the shell mark.

products.name: Hard Hat — Full Brim, Type I Class G
products.std: ANSI/ISEA Z89.1 Type I Class G
products.note: Class G tested to 2,200 V. Full brim sheds water and sun — the roofer's default.

products.name: Safety Glasses — Clear, Anti-Fog
products.note: The + means high impact: 6.35 mm steel ball at 150 ft/s, plus a 500 g pointed drop from 50 in. No mark, no protection.

products.name: Safety Glasses — Smoke, Z87+
products.note: Outdoor tint. Frame and lens both carry the mark — check both, that is where counterfeits fail.

products.name: Sealed Safety Goggle — Indirect Vent
products.note: D3 splash rating. Required where grinding, cutting or chemical splash is present.

products.name: Cut-Resistant Glove — Level A4, PU Palm
products.note: A4 is 1,500–2,199 g of cut resistance. The right default for sheet metal and stud handling.

products.name: Cut-Resistant Glove — Level A6, Nitrile
products.note: A6 is 3,000–3,999 g. Glass handling, heavy gauge steel, demo.

products.name: Leather Driver Glove — Grain Cowhide
products.note: General handling only. If the task has a cut hazard, this is not the glove — and we will tell you so.

products.name: Hi-Vis Vest — Class 2, Type R
products.note: Class 2 for traffic under 50 mph and complex backgrounds. Type R = roadway.

products.name: Hi-Vis Long-Sleeve — Class 3, Type R
products.note: Class 3 required over 50 mph, poor visibility, or where the worker must be seen through a full range of motion.

products.name: Hi-Vis Vest — Class 1, Type O
products.note: Type O is off-road only. Not legal on a public right of way — a common and expensive mix-up.

products.name: Full Body Harness — 5-Point, Universal
products.note: Arrest force limited to 1,800 lb, free fall limited to 6 ft, deceleration distance 3.5 ft.

products.name: Self-Retracting Lifeline — 11 ft, Class 2
products.note: Class 2 permits up to 24 in arrest distance. Check clearance below before you spec any SRL.

products.name: Shock-Absorbing Lanyard — 6 ft, Double Leg
products.note: Needs 18.5 ft of clearance below the anchor. On a low roof this is the wrong product — use an SRL.
